Listing the day's tasks before breakfast

questions.q: How does the summary describe creativity?
a: A skill you practice daily rather than a burst of pure talent
A gift that only a few people are born with
A mood that comes and goes without warning
A reward for finishing other work first
questions.why: Lesson 1 says real artists show up to practice a little every day, and their work compounds.

questions.q: What does the summary suggest when you are blocked?
a: Ask other people to give you a prompt
Wait until inspiration returns on its own
Switch to a completely different art form
Study the work of famous artists
questions.why: Lesson 2 recommends asking a friend, relative or audience what you should make next.

questions.q: What does the gardener metaphor mean?
a: You find ideas and tend them rather than generating them from nothing
You must plant many ideas to get one good one
Ideas grow best when left completely alone
You should weed out anything not profitable
questions.why: Lesson 3 says an artist plants, cares for and grows ideas instead of forcing them into being.

questions.q: What did Michelangelo say about his statue of David?
a: That he found it rather than created it
That it took him twenty years to finish
That he copied it from a Greek original
That he preferred painting to sculpture
questions.why: Lesson 3 uses his claim to illustrate the humble idea of the artist as a vessel.
